volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

recalculateOnTrigger.tooltip: Latch: freeze Model/Attack/Release/Curve/Sensitivity on rising Retrigger. Free: knobs always live. Retrigger never resets the level; unconnected Retrigger = Free.

attack.tooltip: Rise time constant toward a brighter Light target. 0 = instant.

release.tooltip: Fall time constant toward a dimmer Light target (photoconductive lag).

curve.tooltip: Gamma after the one-pole. 1 = linear; >1 digs in; <1 lifts the tail.

partials.tooltip: Partial count cap. Fractional values fade the top partial in (e.g. 3.5 = three partials plus the fourth at half level), so sweeps are smooth.

frequency.tooltip: Default slider 0…20 kHz. Pitch MOD can run down through 0. Thru-zero: enable Bipolar on Frequency (domain-add MOD). Domain min/max are slider guides.

morph.tooltip: Side to side. Trimorph: trisaw peak position (0.5 = triangle, toward 0.01 / 0.99 = saw / ramp). Square (PWM): pulse width. Band-limited at every setting (moves the offset DSF kernel).

blend.tooltip: SquSaw only: saw (0) to square (1), a crossfade of two band-limited waves from the same kernel. Other waveforms ignore it.

bright.tooltip: Harmonic tilt (DSF geometric rolloff): 0 = sine, 1 = the full bright wave. Band-limited at every setting. Nonlinear slider: more sensitivity near 0 (where most of the useful range is).

frequency.tooltip: Hz. Self-osc pitch is referenced at Resonance 0.8. MOD adds Hz.

dither.tooltip: On mixes a noise band highpassed at Frequency and lowpassed at 4×Frequency into the inner oscillator. Left and Right each have their own stream. Start / Full / Amount set the mix.

start.tooltip: Frequency where the noise-band mix begins. Below this the inner oscillator stays clean.

full.tooltip: Frequency where the noise-band mix reaches Amount. Log ramp between Start and Full.

amount.tooltip: Noise-band mix at Full. 0 = inner oscillator only. 1 = replace with the ƒ…4ƒ band.

seed.tooltip: Chaos + dither noise seed. Same Seed = same output; new modules get their own.

tuning.tooltip: A4 reference Hz. MIDI 69 maps to this frequency when converting Pitch→Hz.

low.tooltip: Hz when the 0–1 input is 0. f = Low · (High / Low)^x, unclamped.

high.tooltip: Hz when the 0–1 input is 1. Octave, Semitones, Cents and the pitch input add on top.

octave.tooltip: Add octaves to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

semitones.tooltip: Add semitones to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

cents.tooltip: Add cents / 100 to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

multiply.tooltip: Hz-domain multiply after Pitch→Hz. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

add.tooltip: Hz-domain offset after Multiply. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

polarity.tooltip: Bipolar: outs swing -Amp..+Amp. Unipolar: 0.5*Amp*(v+1), so 0..Amp (0..1 at Amp 1; Amp 0 = 0). Applies to sin and cos.

method.tooltip: Sine SSOT default = Wavetable (additive half-sine LUT 2¹⁵). Polynomial = joint quadrant poly. std::sin = full-range sandbox poly (freestanding; no libm). Taylor = short quadrant-folded Taylor (continuous at wrap).

phase.tooltip: Phase offset (cycles). Knob + Phase MOD from audio-rate sources add sample-accurately.

freq.tooltip: Hz. Parameter MOD is domain-add (base + CV). Set base 0 and wire Pitch Detector / Knob Bias for absolute Hz. Enable Bipolar in param settings for thru-zero FM (negative Hz = reverse phase).

noise.tooltip: Band-limited white noise (4-pole lowpass at 8 kHz, moving with Shift) into the formant bank. Stereo: independent per side.

pw.tooltip: Pulse width of the Square (Wave = Square): the high fraction of the cycle. 0.5 = square. Smooth to sweep (BLIT, alias-free).

subOct.tooltip: Sub one or two octaves under Frequency.

subDirect.tooltip: Share of the Sub sent around the formant bank, straight into Drive: the low end stays steady while the vowels move. 0 = all through the bank.

noiseTone.tooltip: Noise lowpass cutoff (4-pole) at Shift 0; moves with Shift. Low = dark breath, high = bright hiss.

jitter.tooltip: Random pitch change every cycle (1 = +-6 %, about a semitone). A little makes a voice sound alive; a lot sounds rough or old.

shimmer.tooltip: Random loudness change every cycle (1 = +-60 %). A little is natural; a lot is gravelly / vocal fry.

breath.tooltip: Noise as breath: -1 = in (thin, bright, higher, wider, quieter: a gasp), +1 = out (fuller, darker, resonant: a sigh). Shapes Noise, aspiration and H.

plosive.tooltip: A Trigger hit plays this stop consonant into the voice: closure (silence), burst, aspiration, then voicing returns with the formants gliding in from the consonant. Trigger height = strength. P T K voiceless, B D G voiced.

fricative.tooltip: Hiss consonant at Fric Lvl: S / Sh / F / Th are shaped noise added clean after Drive; H is breath through the vowel's formants. With the voice on too you get Z / Zh / V / Dh.

fricLevel.tooltip: Fricative level. Envelope it for sss-ah.

subWave.tooltip: Sub oscillator one octave down (level = Sub). Saw and Square are BLIT (alias-free) and carry harmonics up into the formants; Sine only shows through Body.

rate.tooltip: Pulse rate in Hz. Wired ƒ replaces it (absolute Hz).

width.tooltip: Pulse width in internal samples (48 kHz). 0 = off. Below about 4 the rise and fall overlap and the pulses form sample-grid patterns; from about 4 every pulse reaches full Amp.

speed.tooltip: Runs the whole pattern faster or slower: scales the internal grid (48 kHz x Speed) and Rate together. Low Speed keeps the pattern; once the grid outruns the sample rate the pattern loosens.

mode.tooltip: Pitch→Hz: MIDI-ish pitch to frequency. Hz→Pitch: frequency to pitch (69 = tuning Hz).

tuning.tooltip: A4 reference Hz. MIDI pitch 69 maps to this frequency.
